items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, Bill Johnson played with King Oliver was one of the first

ctx.x: That’s a Bill Johnson, and there’s another Bill Johnson. Bill Johnson was a common name. Must have been a thousand of them in the United States. No, Bill Johnson played with King Oliver was one of the first . . . He was with that Original Creole Band with Freddie Keppard on the Orpheum Circuit.
